subject: Post-call follow-up: data lifecycle, SOC 2 status & log/backups Qs
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call follow-up: data lifecycle, SOC 2 status & log/backups Qs

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the open questions we promised to follow up on from the demo and security discussion: 

1) SOC 2: you asked whether Redwood currently has a SOC 2 report and the scope (auth + infra). Short answer: yes — we completed Type II in Q4 2026 covering the hosted API and production control plane (auth, change mgmt, logging). We'll attach the SOC 2 summary and point you to the control matrix for details.

2) Data retention & deletion: we support configurable tenant-level retention windows for request/response logs (30/90/365 days) and can set a custom policy during Dedicated or Private deployments. For hosted customers, default application logs are retained for 90 days unless contracted otherwise. Backups are kept as encrypted snapshots with a separate retention policy; we can set RPO/RTO targets if you need longer-term archival.

3) Backups & log access: logs required for incident investigation are available via audit exports; we can provide S3 exports or Drive links. For backup restores, we have documented runbooks and can commit an RTO in Dedicated contracts.

4) GDPR/HIPAA and erase requests: in hosted mode we support data subject erasure requests via API and have a documented erasure workflow. For PHI workloads we recommend Private (VPC/on-prem) and our HIPAA addendum.

Next steps (from our side):
- Send SOC 2 summary + control matrix link (attached).
- Share a short vendor-security questionnaire for you to fill out — if you prefer I can start with our answers and then send to your security team.
- Confirm whether the 90-day default retention is acceptable for your PoC or if you want a different window.

Can you confirm the preferred security contact and whether you want the questionnaire pre-filled? Also flag any required retention numbers (e.g., 7 years for audits) so we can surface options.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments referenced: redwood_soc2_statement.pdf (summary), control-matrix-link in Drive
From: Alex Park <alex.park@helixhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, security-ops@helixhealth.com
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: data lifecycle, SOC 2 status & log/backups Qs

Thanks Irene — helpful summary. A couple of clarifying items from our security team:

- Can you confirm the exact control domains included in the Type II report? We need to verify logging & change management controls specifically for the hosted API.
- For log retention: does the 90-day default include request/response payloads or only metadata (timestamps, user IDs, operation types)? We have to assess exposure of PHI fields.
- Backups: are backup snapshots encrypted with customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) or Redwood-managed keys for hosted customers?

Security wants the vendor questionnaire to start with your answers so we can see the details before filling. Please attach your SOC 2 summary and the questionnaire template when you send. Also include any redaction guidance for payload-sensitive fields in logs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Alex
Alex Park
Sr. Product Security Manager, Helix Health
alex.park@helixhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call follow-up: data lifecycle, SOC 2 status & log/backups Qs

Irene — copying Evelyn for legal/BAA ops. Draft answers that we should include in the vendor questionnaire and in the follow-up to Alex: 

- SOC 2 scope: Auth, change management, system ops, logging/monitoring, backup & recovery are covered. We'll provide the control matrix PDF (redwood_soc2_statement.pdf) and a short summary bullet list of tested controls.

- Log retention: Hosted default retains full request/response logs for 90 days; metadata-only for 365+ (depending on contract). For PHI-sensitive fields we can support automated redaction at ingestion or field-level masking on request.

- Backup encryption: Hosted snapshots are encrypted with Redwood-managed KMS by default; customer-managed keys are available for Dedicated contracts and Private deployments (BYOK). We should clearly call out the distinction in the response.

- Erasure: We have an API-driven erasure workflow documented; for hosted we give a 48–72 hour SLA for propagation and verified deletion from index/search layers; archival restores are subject to retention windows unless explicitly purged.

Action items: 
- Irene: send SOC2 summary + control matrix and attach the vendor questionnaire pre-filled where possible.
- Evelyn: can you confirm the 48–72h erasure SLA language and whether Legal needs to approve the wording before we send?

I'll be on the Helix call Wednesday so will help close this.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: security-ops@helixhealth.com
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Park <alex.park@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: data lifecycle, SOC 2 status & log/backups Qs

Hi Irene / Ben —

Thanks for the quick responses. We prefer you pre-fill the vendor questionnaire and include any sample redaction configs. Attached is our template (Helix_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf). Please upload the SOC 2 summary and control matrix, and confirm the following in writing: 

• That hosted-mode request/response retention includes full payloads by default for 90 days (we may request a shorter window for PHI).
• That BYOK is available only on Dedicated/Private deployments and not for hosted customers by default.
• The erasure SLA (48–72 hours) and what is excluded (snapshots marked for longer-term archive).

Prefer a single consolidated PDF with your answers to our questionnaire and the SOC 2 summary. If you can get that over today we can route to Legal for an initial review.

Regards,
Helix Security Ops
security-ops@helixhealth.com

Attachments referenced: Helix_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf
